methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched from official vendor pricing pages via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. Attentive publishes no self-serve USD prices (all quote/demo-only); recorded with null monthlyUsd. Klaviyo pricing page geo-redirected to German locale on first attempt; confirmed USD figures via SoftwareAdvice profile (corroboration). Postscript shows dual rates (old/new) on page — current lower rates recorded. SimpleTexting uses a dynamic calculator; base 500-credit plan confirmed at $29/mo base + $10/mo local number = $39/mo total on official page, and the full tier list confirmed via SoftwareAdvice. Omnisend pricing confirmed at $11.20 Standard / $41.30 Pro from direct site; SoftwareAdvice showed higher figures (likely stale). EZ Texting confirmed monthly and annual prices on official page. SlickText confirmed full plan table on two official page fetches. Textmagic is pure prepaid usage-based with no flat plans. All accessedAt dates set to 2026-06-14 per dataset spec.
